title: Stuibenfall Klettersteig Umhausen
highlights: Family-friendly via ferrata running alongside Tyrol's tallest waterfall
Spectacular wire rope suspension bridge spanning directly over the rushing torrent
Boldly placed viewing platforms offering breathtaking views of the 159 m cascade
Cooling water spray and thrilling climbing across grippy gneiss rock
kurzbeschreibung: The Stuibenfall-Klettersteig in Umhausen ascends spectacularly alongside Tirol's highest waterfall, featuring a suspension bridge over the spray.
beschreibung:
Climbing by the Roaring Waterfall

The Stuibenfall-Klettersteig in Umhausen is among Austria's most popular via ferratas. Right beside the 159-metre-high Stuibenfall waterfall, the route leads upwards over grippy gneiss, offering fascinating views into the foaming torrents.

Highlight Rope Bridge

The via ferrata is graded B/C and features climbing rungs that make it accessible even to experienced children. The absolute centerpiece of the route is the airy rope bridge suspended directly above the waterfall's drop-off edge, delivering unforgettable thrills and spectacular photo opportunities.
